title: ElevenLabs Dubbing
description: Generate dubbed videos or audios using ElevenLabs Dubbing feature!

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.6 per minute. The calculation will be based on the closest minute after rounding upwards.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.tooltip: URL of the audio file to dub. Either audio_url or video_url must be provided.

inputs.name: video
inputs.tooltip: URL of the video file to dub. Either audio_url or video_url must be provided. If both are provided, video_url takes priority.

inputs.name: source_lang
inputs.tooltip: Source language code. If not provided, will be auto-detected. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: num_speakers
inputs.tooltip: Number of speakers in the audio. If not provided, will be auto-detected. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: highest_resolution
inputs.tooltip: Whether to use the highest resolution for dubbing.
